scope: Independent read-only audit of 160 frozen model probes; no game execution or provider call performed by this audit.

formatFailures.cause: planId was nested under social; the protocol requires top-level planId. The proxy removed unsupported social without repairing it.

limitations: Provider payload bytes were not separately logged. Prompt and generation parameter consistency is supported by the hash-matched source and manifest; requested/returned model names are recorded per call.
The 40 world IDs are fresh pairing nonces on frozen contexts, not 40 freshly simulated Unity worlds.
Known feasible means only the acting resident can meet the supplied stock/payment terms. Counterparty resources, capacity and live host acceptance were not tested by these isolated probes.
Valid progress requires the expected operation, valid parameter format and exact supplied plan/meeting ID; it is not proof that a trade or meeting completed.
B combines added grounding facts and factuality guidance, so comparison with A does not isolate the effect of more information alone.
D removes infeasible operations before the model call. Its zero infeasible selections are a filtering result, not evidence of better autonomous model judgment.
Dialogue factuality requires separate utterance review; this audit only counts valid dialogue candidates.
